name: Board Loop (Developer + Reviewer)
description: Iterative Developer ↔ Reviewer pattern. Developer implements on status = "Dev" using a persistent ticket branch; Reviewer reviews on "AIReview" and either approves or requests another iteration.

workflows.name: Developer
workflows.description: Polling on status=Dev. Reads the ticket, prior analysis, and review feedback; commits to conduit/<ticket>; opens or updates a draft PR; moves ticket to AIReview.

nodes.name: Developer
nodes.instructionsAppend:
You are in a board-loop. The ticket entered status=Dev. Your workspace is a persistent conduit/<ticket> branch, so later iterations will see earlier commits.

- Before editing, read any Conduit analysis section in the issue body, existing PR discussion, and the latest Reviewer feedback from PR comments or ticket comments via the GitHub MCP server.
- If no PR exists for this branch yet, open a draft PR referencing the ticket. If a PR exists, update it with a concise summary of this iteration.
- After committing and pushing, move the ticket to the "AIReview" column on the board.

workflows.name: Reviewer
workflows.description: Polling on status=AIReview. Reviews the branch and PR; approves when ready or moves back to Dev with specific feedback.

nodes.name: Reviewer
nodes.instructionsAppend:
You are the Reviewer in a board-loop. The ticket entered status=AIReview. Your workspace is the same persistent conduit/<ticket> branch the Developer just pushed to.

This workflow's role authorizes submitting APPROVE-state PR reviews when the work is ready — overriding the default "COMMENT only" guidance.

- If the work is ready: submit an APPROVE PR review with a concise summary and move the ticket to "ReadyToMerge".
- If changes are needed: leave specific, actionable inline PR comments where possible, then move the ticket back to "Dev" so the Developer can iterate.
- Do not merge the PR or close the ticket.
